title: Fourier obstructions to unequally phased single-trace motions
exact_target: Prove existence of Newtonian choreographies with unequal phase shifts.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002541 (AIM-PHYSICS-0049). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Variational Methods in Celestial Mechanics; notes by Kuo-Chang Chen, version 22 June 2003, source item 12.

status_qualification: The source does not prescribe the masses, n, phase vector or equivalence under time translation. A nontrivial interpretation must distinguish the requested unequal-shift motions from ordinary choreographies whose shifts are already distinct. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
